messages.subject: xlim and ylim with plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace
parts: How do I put limits on the x and y axis with plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace? I tried using ylim and xlim in the list of plotting parameters supplied to the plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace function but this didn't work.

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] xlim and ylim with plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace
parts:
Nic, these settings are not available in plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace right now.

In fact, this function will soon be deprecated and substituted by a new one. Please bare with us for some time until we release the new version of geomorph, which will visibly increase flexibility for this kind of things.

Antigoni
